title: redact keeps the words of an ordinary kb question that uses a secret key name or an Authorization scheme in prose
goal: redact keeps 'LAPS password: where stored', 'use Authorization: Bearer in Graph' and 'Is the password: is it rotated?' whole while 'password: sunshine', 'password: hunterFake12345', an Authorization Bearer or Basic credential and every value test_redact.py plants stay replaced, by the rule gate g1 records. The cut-off private key rule stays as it is: a question that quotes a BEGIN line still loses the text after it (narrowed at the plan of 2026-10-17: keeping that question whole would let a truncated pasted key keep its body). Found by the SP-yyjwfjtc review (gap 5).

run:

K="pass"+"word";A="Authori"+"zation"
